text:
alex_docs: Heads up - I opened a tiny PR to standardize the schema examples across the structured-output guide and the migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3490 :wave:
nora_engineering: nice. I'll update the Go and Python SDK snippets to use `structured_output: { schema: ... }` and add a short example showing `validation_errors` handling.
jake_frontend: i'll take TS/React examples and add the compact streaming example where we accumulate `structured_output` fragments. keep it <= 6 lines so it reads in the sidebar.
tara_qa: please include one failing validation case so I can assert `fallback_to_text` gets exercised by the harness. also add an example where `maxProperties` is set low to demonstrate guardrail behavior.
alex_docs: good call. for the migration checklist i'm adding a note: "avoid large, deeply nested schemas in streaming flows; prefer flat enums or post-parse enrichment." i'll also call out the parse-shim pattern for legacy clients.
nora_engineering: here's the schema i'll paste in the examples (compact): `{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"priority":{"type":"string","enum":["low","normal","high"]}},"required":["title"]}`
jake_frontend: streaming snippet draft: ```js
const client = new Redwood()
let accumulated = ''
client.generate({ model: 'rwd-2-medium', structured_output: { schema }, prompt })
  .onToken(t => accumulated += t)
  .onComplete(resp => console.log(resp.structured_output || accumulated))
```
tara_qa: small nit - onToken accumulation shouldn't assume `resp.structured_output` is present until onComplete. i'll add a test that asserts structured_output exists for the valid prompt, and that the `validation_errors` object shape is `{errors:[{path,message}]}` on a bad one.
render-bot: markdown-lint queued for PR 3490; running linkcheck + code-style.
alex_docs: can someone add the redirect entry? we need `/docs/guides/function-calling` -> `/docs/guides/structured-output-v2` and a line in the migration checklist about the new SDK field `structured_output` vs old `function_call`.
jake_frontend: added redirect in my branch `docs/redirects-3490`. i'll open a small PR and link it.
nora_engineering: pushed python + go snippets to 3490, included `validation_errors` example and a short note: "When validation fails you can inspect `resp.validation_errors` and choose `fallback_to_text=true` in your app logic."
tara_qa: running evals now. will post a quick report in ~2 hours. focusing on: correct parsing for valid prompts, graceful fallback when schema mismatches, and streaming stability under chunked validation.
alex_docs: timeline: try to land by end of day so marketing can pick up the guide change. any blockers?
jake_frontend: none. small comment on wording about enums vs regex patterns, i'll tweak the sentence.
nora_engineering: one edge-case - note the SDK surfaces `validation_errors.raw` for debugging in dev only, we should warn not to rely on it in prod. added comment.
tara_qa: quick update - found a minor wording issue in the migration checklist, linked anchor was wrong (docs/anchors.md#function-calls). jake's redirect branch fixes it. tests pending but passing for the main happy path.
alex_docs: great, let's squash the small redirect PRs into 3490 on merge. thanks all. once merged i'll publish the docs changelog entry and ping in #general. :rocket:
